why: The star moves one box clockwise inside the window from left to right. Row 1: top-left, top-right, bottom-right. Row 3: bottom-left, top-left, so next is top-right. Option 1 has the star at the top-right. Option 3 moves it two steps.
trick: Watch the direction of movement in row 1 and apply the same steps to the missing row.
